verdict.rationale: Dagster+ ships an official MCP server that lets AI agents 'access information and take actions' in a deployment, which plausibly covers checking sync status and re-triggering runs, and Dagster also maintains AI skills for agent context. However, no evidence explicitly confirms diagnosing a failed run or re-triggering it via MCP/API, and a probe found no discoverable REST/OpenAPI API (only GraphQL implied, not documented here). Missing for 10: concrete documentation/example of diagnosing a failed run and re-triggering via MCP or API, and confirmation of a general-purpose REST/GraphQL API surface for such actions outside Dagster+.
